fusion_trade.note: Fewer, larger kernels: the launch count fell by a third while device time rose. The broadcast machinery it removed is the saving; every other kernel is the bill.

provenance.note: Both profiles are the baseline arm over the same 120-step window, so a difference is upstream's. The earlier profile is not in the workspace and was fetched by revision with `calkit dvc get . results/nsys/baseline.sqlite --rev <commit>`.

register_pressure.note: The count of heavy functions did not rise, so this is the same few kernels getting heavier rather than new ones appearing.
